title: Practice 5: To whom: giving, telling, showing

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Оставалось, следовательно, отдать ___ (наш генерал) последний долг.
exercises.why: «The dative case is used mostly to denote the person to whom something is given, sent, told, shown, etc.» — DLI, Lesson 28.
